original: ק֣וֹל קוֹרֵ֔א בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֕ר פַּנּ֖וּ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהוָ֑ה יַשְּׁרוּ֙ בָּ/עֲרָבָ֔ה מְסִלָּ֖ה לֵ/אלֹהֵֽי/נוּ׃
translation: A voice is calling: In the wilderness prepare the way of the LORD; make straight in the desert plain a highway for our God.
literal_notes: בַּמִּדְבָּר could belong with 'calling' (MT accents place it with 'prepare')
uncertainties: Phrase division: 'a voice calls in the wilderness' vs. 'in the wilderness prepare' (the Hebrew accents favor the latter; the Gospels and LXX take the former)
differences_from_web: WEB reads 'The voice of one who calls out'; mine 'A voice is calling' (qol as exclamation)
_web_text: The voice of one who calls out, “Prepare the way of the LORD in the wilderness! Make a level highway in the desert for our God.
